records.text: The knife slices into my finger. I feel:
My tooth throbs with each heartbeat. I feel:
A migraine pounds behind my eyes. I feel:
I twist my ankle on the stairs. I feel:
A heaviness weighs on me constantly. I feel:
My racing thoughts spiral out of control. I feel:
A wave of loss hits me unexpectedly. I feel:
I cannot escape these intrusive thoughts. I feel:
My best friend stops returning my calls. I feel:
The group chat goes silent when I speak. I feel:
I overhear them mocking me behind my back. I feel:
My partner says they need space from me. I feel:
I lied to protect myself and harmed them. I feel:
My silence allowed the injustice to continue. I feel:
I chose my career over my dying father. I feel:
The secret I keep destroys my integrity. I feel:
The problem defeats me no matter how I try. I feel:
My understanding of the situation was completely wrong. I feel:
I cannot reconcile these contradictory facts. I feel:
The complexity of the decision overwhelms me. I feel:
The footsteps behind me get closer. I feel:
My doctor says the results are concerning. I feel:
A shadow moves in my peripheral vision. I feel:
I hear glass breaking downstairs at night. I feel:
The mess my roommate left infuriates me. I feel:
My food arrives cold and wrong again. I feel:
I step in something foul on the sidewalk. I feel:
The customer service puts me on hold forever. I feel:
I read about the extinction of another species. I feel:
The war footage shows children in the rubble. I feel:
I learn the glacier has retreated further. I feel:
The famine spreads to another region. I feel:
I arrange the books on my shelf alphabetically. I feel:
My coffee maker finishes brewing. I feel:
I sort through the mail on my desk. I feel:
The meeting ends exactly on time. I feel:
A yawn overtakes me in the afternoon. I feel:
My stomach growls before dinner. I feel:
I stretch after sitting for too long. I feel:
The warm shower relaxes my muscles. I feel:
